description: This Kotlin source file defines a UI component for a chat input area in an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It includes data classes, composable functions for rendering the chat input, attachment strip, buttons, and menu items along with their logic and styling.

classes.name: DraftApplication
classes.description: Data class representing a draft message with input text, the last applied draft, and a consumed flag.

methods.name: applyDraftText
methods.description: Determines whether to apply a new draft text based on current input and previous draft, returning an updated DraftApplication object.
